## Real-device result: 24 cases, 22 passed, 0 failed, 2 Blocked

ATC-DEV-M5-06 and ATC-DEV-INT-02 (live camera session) are **Blocked**. When the MIUI "Install via USB" prompt was not confirmed,
Flutter uninstalled and reinstalled the test build, which reset its camera permission to "denied". The tests never grant permissions.

## Test-code corrections between runs (the app was not changed to make tests pass)

- run1: the screenshot helper hung because no frame was pumped after the surface conversion. Bounded waits and per-case timeouts were added.
- run2: a `FirebaseException` came from the Profile tab. The tests now initialise Firebase with nobody signed in, and stop as Blocked if an account is signed in.
- run4: the menu was found by semantic label instead of tooltip; the warm-up time is shown as "3m"; the flow assumed today is a training day.
- run5: the debug connection to the phone was lost midway (not counted).
- run6: the scroll helper picked the horizontal tab pager; "Use Manual Guidance" only switches the mode; the summary opens by itself after the last set; the camera precheck was added.
- All runs: only the first case per run saved a screenshot (the surface conversion is reset after every test). Fixed in the helper.

## Side effect on the phone (reported to the user)

`flutter drive` without `--keep-app-running` uninstalls the app when it finishes. The first two smoke runs therefore removed
`com.example.app` together with its local sign-in. Cloud data was not affected. `run_on_device.sh` now always passes `--keep-app-running`.
The normal Baymax build was reinstalled at the end; the user needs to sign in once.

- App code: none in this round. The "Close voice assistant" accessibility label was added in the previous round.
